description: This file defines a TorchScript-compatible functional implementation of the Adadelta optimizer for distributed training within PyTorch. It includes a class `_FunctionalAdadelta` with initialization and step methods, intended for internal distributed optimizer use, and utilizes TorchScript for compilation.
